version_note: Full served trained-model revision identifier is authoritative; dataset version 2 is not a claim about checkpoint epoch. ONNX model_version=0 is a format default.
acquisition: Existing artifact from the successful TASK16-B-1 model load; SHA-256 frozen. No re-export or download.
confidence: sigmoid, global top300, strict > threshold, exclude background then class-index shift; no objectness multiplication
bbox: normalized cxcywh -> xyxy * original decoded width/height -> clip; no letterbox offset
mask: resize mask logits to image dimensions, threshold >0, largest external contour by vertex count
